{{Quote|The Congress of Malastare concurs with the honorable delegate from the Trade Federation. A commission must be appointed.|Aks Moe|<ref name="TPM" />}}
'''Aks Moe''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] representing the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was noted for his delight in bureaucratic minutiae and was a prime example of the inefficiencies of the late-form Galactic Congress. He represented the Gran Protectorate jointly at times with [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] and [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]], who both later continued to serve him as [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representatives]] until his [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Galactic Senator===
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]<ref name="db" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|322|Moe, Aks}}</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWEMalastare">{{CSWECite|II|279–280|Malastare}}</ref> [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]],<ref name="CSWE" /> Aks Moe lived a life of opulence on the planet with indentured [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] servants, who were little more than [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="db" /> Moe became involved in politics within the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] on his homeworld [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], eventually attaining the position of [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Pax Teem]] by [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]]. Alongside Teem, Moe attended a gala on his homeworld in celebration of the Dug winners of the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]]. [[52 BBY/Legends|Two years later]], Moe was not on Coruscant when Teem and other members of the Gran Protectorate's delegation on the planet were [[Massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy|massacred]] under mysterious circumstances.<ref name="SWDP" />

[[File:Aks Moe TPM.png|thumb|200px|left|Aks Moe seconded Lott Dod's demand that a commission investigate Queen Amidala's claims.]]
Following the attack on Coruscant, Aks Moe was approached by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to work out a deal that would guarantee his support; Moe was appointed as the Senator of the Protectorate soon after.<ref name="SWDP" /> He began to serve jointly with [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] as of [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]] also joined their joint representation of Malastare.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Baskol Yeesrim}}</ref>

In 32 BBY, when [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] presented a plea for help from the Senate against the Trade Federation, Moe attempted to delay decisive action against the Federation, seconding a motion to send a survey team to Naboo to confirm the alleged attack. His obstruction demonstrated to Amidala the weaknesses of the body and she initiated a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Valorum]].<ref name="db" />

In the ensuing political chaos, Ainlee Teem was nominated to succeed as Chancellor by Senator [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]] of [[Roona/Legends|Roona]]. While he ran a fierce campaign against the other candidates [[Bail Antilles/Legends|Bail Antilles]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Naboo, he was ultimately defeated by the latter.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

After the election, Moe returned to Malastare to attend peace negotiations between the warring factions involved in the civil war on [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]]; the meetings also happened to run concurrent with the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] podracing event. The senator secretly conspired with [[Myk'chur Finux Zug]], the leader of the terrorist [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] delegation, to kill Prince [[R'cardo Sooflie IX]] with [[Akk dog/Legends|akk dogs]] and establish a new government in which the Gran senator would take advantage of the planet's unexploited resources. The plot was foiled and Zug killed thanks to the delegation of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] responsible for mediating between the parties, and although the Jedi suspected the involvement of the Gran authorities in the plot, a lack of evidence allowed Moe to avoid blame and retained his position for the time being.<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Emissaries to Malastare">''[[Star Wars: Emissaries to Malastare]]''</ref>

===Separatist Crisis===
[[File:AargauAccident-HNN.png|thumb|left|200px|Aks Moe is killed in an explosion.]]
Over the next few years, Moe retained his seat in the Senate, becoming a founding member of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] as a secessionist movement began to take hold. As the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] grew more volatile and more and more star systems broke away, Moe actively voiced his [[Militarists/Legends|Militarist]] views and was a vocal proponent of the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]].<ref name="hnn 49" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Moe was visiting the banking world of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]] to meet with representatives of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] in order to discuss possible funding options for a proposed Republic military initiative. Moe boarded his staff speeder for a visit to the [[Commodities Exchange Cathedral]] in [[New Escrow]] and had only just merged onto an automated expressway when the speeder's power core overloaded and exploded, killing the Senator instantly. Moe's traveling companion and two [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] servants were also killed in the blast, along with the injury of eighteen commuters.<ref name="hnn 50" />

===Legacy===
[[File:AksMoeFuneral.jpg|thumb|220px|Senator Moe's funeral is disrupted by [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] activists.]]
An investigation found that the bomb had been made using [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] parts. Although investigators said that Baktoid components were widely available and thus not conclusive, many people thought that Separatists were responsible despite not claiming credit for the attack.<ref name="hnn bomb">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_2.html|Moe's Bomb Identified}}</ref> Aks Moe's body was transported back to Malastare, where a [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] was held in honor of Moe's service to the Protectorate. During the ceremony, [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] activists of the [[Dugs-for-Democracy]] movement took to the skies in [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]] in a successful attempt to disrupt the corrupt Senator's memorial service.<ref name="hnn 51 funeral">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|regional/13411_1.html|Moe Funeral Disrupted by Dug Activists}}</ref>

In the following months, acting Senator [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] would be officially recognized as Moe's replacement in the Senate.<ref name="hnn 53">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|news/13425_2.html|Senator Aak Officially Appointed}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], Aks Moe was mistakenly referred to as [[Baskol Yeesrim/Legends|Baskol Yeesrim]], who instead was his aide in the Senate. This mistake was corrected in future publications.
